integrity: The five-state recurrence is reconstructed directly from the source update. Stability is characterized by necessary-and-sufficient Schur conditions, with an exact rational checker replaying the matrix characteristic polynomial and boundary identities. Finite checks support but do not replace the algebraic proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar identity-dynamics analysis with equal penalties, equal proximal parameters, and exact Gauss--Seidel subproblem solves. No robust conclusion is claimed for unequal parameters, nonlinear dynamics, multidimensional noncommuting blocks, or stochastic/inexact solves.
title: Exact global-coupling frontier for proximal multiblock ADMM on a three-state chain
